podcasts.name: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Formed by Former Tokens Members
podcast.body: Jay Siegel and Hank Medress formed this group with two other singers after the initial lineup of The Tokens had split up. "But Siegel and one of the other group members, Hank Madress, had carried on performing together, and had formed a new group, Darryl and the Oxfords with two other singers."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 92: "The Lion Sleeps Tonight" by the Tokens

podcast.title: Short-lived Group
podcast.body: The group made a couple of records but eventually split up, leading Siegel and Medress to invite new members and reform as The Tokens. "But that group had also split up, so the duo invited yet another pair of singers to join them, Mitch Margot, who was around their age in his late teens, and his 12-year-old brother Phil."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
